text: Bro. Why is there a lawn chair in my driveway?
Man, you really came. Okay. I respect it. I came prepared too.
It's a legal napkin. Read it.
Wow. So it's like that. I bring you a whole financial plan, and you disrespect my napkin.
Nah, I'm hurt. Real friends take napkins.
Fine. You want it right now? Here. Paid in full.
Forty dollar gift card. We good. Enjoy your breakfast, Skip.
